analysis.method: Viewed overview (61 frames), transitions sheet (all 6 boundaries, every 2nd frame), listen sheet (3 dictation phrases and 12 accent hits), strips 23.2-26.0 s at 10 fps and 29.5-34.7 s at 5 fps; automated audio and listen metrics. analysis.coverage: Full 45.6 s; act fades and the lamp climax at strip level.

concept.observed: A wordless story: a title card; a lighthouse in fog with its beam sweeping; inside, the keeper wakes in a chair, takes a lantern and leaves; he climbs a spiral stair; in the lantern room he lights the lamp, which swells to full brightness; outside, the lit lamp room with the keeper at the rail; the beam sweeps again; an end mark.
concept.interpreted: Duty done; the light is both the subject and the climax.

communication_style.observed: No words except the title and the end mark; the story is told by light and silhouette.

palette.observed: Near-black blue-grey night (99% dark frames) with warm amber lamp and lantern light; fog.

typography.observed: Widely tracked serif caps for the title; a small script end mark.

composition.observed: Ultra-wide 2.35:1 (1694x720); small figures; the lighthouse off-centre; the lamp centred in the climax.

depth_and_layering.observed: Silhouette layers at several depths with fog between them; a rotating beam with soft falloff; lantern light cones.

motion.observed: The beam rotates; fog drifts; the keeper walks in a silhouette walk cycle; the lamp glow grows.

transitions.observed: 6 boundaries (2 cuts, 4 soft). Fade in from black at 3.4-3.9 s; a cut to the interior at 9.90 s; a dark dip at 17.5-18.3 s as the lantern leaves; fade to black at 23.6-24.4 s, black hold 24.4-25.2 s, fade up 25.3-25.9 s; the soft boundaries at 29.85 and 33.00 s are the lamp brightening, not transitions; a cut to the exterior at 34.60 s, 1.4 s after the brightness peak (33.1-33.3 s); fade to black at 43.2-43.7 s and the end mark.
transitions.interpreted: Fades through black are the act breaks; the only two cuts change location.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Acts of 6-10 s; shots of 5-20 s; the climax swell lasts 3.4 s.

sound_design.observed: -14.2 LUFS, LRA 6.4 LU, true peak -1.0 dBTP; tempo estimate 152 bpm (medium, unverified); only 14 accents (18.4/min), grouped where the keeper walks: 14.05-15.39 s across the room, 17.86-19.11 s every 0.42 s on the stair, 21.06-22.71 s and 26.87 s. No accent within 100 ms of any of the 6 boundaries (chance 6%). 0.6 s of silence at the end; head 3.4 dB below the body. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Consistent with footsteps timed to the walk cycle: the sound follows the character, not the edit.

narration.observed: None: dictation returned 10 raw words, 3 above confidence 0.2, single words at 15.7, 28.3 and 34.6 s over walking and exterior frames with nobody speaking (recogniser noise).

captions.observed: None; the title card and the end mark are the only text.

motifs.observed: Light against dark: beam, lantern, lamp; the spiral stair.

scenes.observed: Title card fades in and out on black.
Exterior: the lighthouse in fog, the beam sweeping.
Interior: the keeper wakes and leaves with a lantern.
Lantern room: the lamp is lit and swells.
Exterior: the lit lamp room, the keeper at the rail.
Wide exterior with the beam; fade to black; end mark.

moments.observed: The lamp is lit; its glow and the whole frame brighten for 3.4 s to a flare at 33.1-33.3 s, settle, and the film cuts outside at 34.60 s.
moments.interpreted: The light swell is the climax; the cut releases it.

moments.observed: Accents every 0.42 s while the keeper climbs the stair, each on a step.

difficult: Volumetric fog and the rotating beam would need a Blender plate or layered gradients
Silhouette walk cycles need hand animation or a rig
uncertainties: Whether the accents are footsteps or part of the score (nothing was listened to)
Whether the 152 bpm estimate reflects a pulse in the music
